title: Agent Instruction Template (AGENTS.md)
summary: Canonical agent instruction template governing agent behavior, conventions, and tool usage. Referenced by the docs site and steward context assembler as the authoritative instruction source.

sections.content: AGENTS.md is the canonical agent instruction template for Rig Relay. It governs agent behavior, coding conventions, tool usage, git discipline, and documentation policy. It is an allowed Markdown exception under the documentation policy.

AGENTS.md serves as the foundational instruction set for all agents operating within the Rig Relay codebase. It defines module conventions, Python style, typing rules, async expectations, tool hardening, test discipline, git policy, and documentation governance.

The steward context assembler (rig_relay/governance/steward_context_assembler.py) tracks AGENTS.md as a known instruction source file. The context envelope bridge (rig_relay/governance/context_envelope_bridge.py) discovers AGENTS.md as a required instruction file during governed context compilation.

items: Docs site: references AGENTS.md via this governance page in the Governance collection
Steward context assembler: tracks AGENTS.md content hash as an instruction source file
Context envelope bridge: discovers AGENTS.md as a required instruction file
Ralph scanner: reads AGENTS.md rules for conventions and compliance checks
Agent initialization: loads AGENTS.md into agent context at session start
Documentation Policy — defines AGENTS.md as an allowed Markdown exception
Cross-Session Coordination — AGENTS.md rules for multi-agent coordination
Agent Loop Boundary — governed by AGENTS.md conventions
Context Compiler Doctrine — references AGENTS.md as instruction source
Security Hygiene — AGENTS.md defines tool hardening rules
